skills.description: 会计准则技能，提供企业会计准则的查询、解读和对会计分录的合规审计能力。已学习13项准则（基本准则+12项具体准则）和6项准则解释（第15~20号），覆盖中小企业日常核算的核心场景。
skills.description_zh:
会计准则技能 (accounting-standards)
定位：通用会计准则查询与分录合规审计技能，可独立使用或作为会计归档技能的补充包。

核心能力
准则查询：根据准则编号或关键词快速检索准则全文和关键条款
准则解读：结合实务业务场景解读准则要求，提供操作指引
分录合规审计：对照准则及准则解释检查现有会计分录的合规性，识别潜在问题
数据来源
首选权威来源：财政部会计准则委员会官网 https://www.casc.org.cn/
权威来源（税收政策）：国家税务总局 https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/（出口退税管理办法、增值税/消费税征管规定等税收政策文件）
可信补充来源：财政部会计司 (kjs.mof.gov.cn)、上海国家会计学院 (snai.edu)、厦门国家会计学院
如不特别提示，准则查询和解读基于上述可信来源发布的原文和准则解释，不引用第三方解读
使用方法
准则查询
当需要查询某项准则或准则解释时，直接读取 references/ 目录下的对应文件。完整索引见 references/准则索引.md。

每个准则/解释文件包含：核心条款 + 业务关联分析 + 原文链接备注

输出准则或准则解释时，必须附带财政部会计准则委员会官网对应的原文链接备注，不可省略。
skills.name: 会计准则标准

skills.description: Using fixed cameras at home, kindergartens, or playgrounds, the system analyzes children's behavior and expressions in real time to identify happy moments: big laughter (mouth corners sharply raised, eyes squinted into crescents, teeth showing), jumping (both feet off the ground), clapping (rhythmic hand clapping), and joyful reactions to praise or rewards. When a happy event is detected, the system automatically captures a high-definition photo or a short video clip (2 seconds before and after), generates a 'Happy Diary' pushed to the parent's mobile APP, and plays an encouragement sound (such as 'You're amazing!' or cheerful music). This helps record positive emotions during the child's growth, strengthens parent-child interaction, and nurtures confidence. Application scenarios: family living rooms, kindergarten classrooms, playgrounds, parent-child activity centers. The system monitors in real time, automatically captures happy moments, and generates daily/weekly happiness collections. Skill features: a child's happy moments are short and precious; busy parents often miss them. AI auto-capture helps preserve beautiful memories, while instant encouragement reinforces positive behavior and supports mental well-being. Cuts through the complexity of personal finance with psychological insight, behavioral economics, and practical habits anyone can follow.  Covers 5 use cases: ① Saving & Spending — build a sustainable savings habit without deprivation, understand the psychological traps leading to overspending ("I can never save money" "Why do I keep spending on things I don't need" "How do I live within my means") ② Debt Management — distinguish good debt from bad debt, develop a strategy to reduce and eliminate consumer debt ("I'm drowning in debt" "Should I use a line of credit" "What's the fastest way to pay off debt") ③ Investing Fundamentals — avoid common investing mistakes, understand why index funds beat active management, ignore the noise ("How do I start investing" "Why do my mutual funds underperform" "Should I time the market") ④ Behavioral Finance — recognize psychological biases that sabotage financial decisions ("Why do I make dumb money decisions" "How do emotions affect my finances" "I know what to do but can't do it") ⑤ Home & Life Planning — navigate big financial decisions: buying vs renting, mortgages, emergency funds, estate planning ("Should I buy or rent" "How much house can I afford" "Do I need an emergency fund")  Trigger when users say: "I can't save money" "I need financial advice" "How to get out of debt" "Where should I invest" "I spend too much" "Living paycheck to paycheck" "How to build wealth" "Should I buy a house" "Credit card debt" "I need a financial plan" "How to budget" "Stop overspending" "Financial freedom" "Money management" "Personal finance tips" or mention: Dave Chilton / Wealthy Barber / truth about financial freedom / personal finance / behavioral economics / saving vs spending / index funds / consumer debt / living within means / pay yourself first / emergency fund / mortgage / line of credit / RRSP / TFSA / financial independence. skills.description: 将模糊的用户想法转化为专家级产品规格提示词。当用户要求"润色提示词"、"帮我把想法写成 prompt"、"我想做一个 XXX"，或希望将简单描述扩展为包含精确技术细节的专业规格时，使用此技能。
skills.description_zh:
LeadSense：让你的 Prompt 像一份无懈可击的首席架构师蓝图。LeadSense 是一款将模糊意图转化为高确定性 “工程规格书” 的提示词优化引擎。它的核心不是修辞润色，而是领域知识下沉—— 将资深开发者（Lead）对性能、交互细节及工程边界的直觉（Sense）注入到 Prompt 中。
一、使用步骤
初稿输入：提供一段非专业的、描述性的功能构思。
示例：“做一个按住键说话转文字的 macOS 工具，要酷炫一点。”
深度润色：LeadSense 介入，通过 “解构 - 注入 - 重构” 流程，输出包含技术栈选择（如 Native vs Electron）、细节权重及逻辑约束的专业规格书。
执行交付：将生成的结构化 Prompt 复制给 Claude Code、GPT 等执行端，实现 “全程不改一行码” 的高质量产出。
二、注意事项
工程导向：本 Skill 专为技术实现设计，不适用于纯创意写作或文学润色。
skills.name: LeadSense
